text: The document listener finds the clicked anchor, returns early without one, and calls launchBrowser with href and the original event. Current launchBrowser handles button/protocol guards and cancels default handling on its ordinary external-open path. The integration test stubs that global, checks the forwarded HTTPS/mailto URI and cancels the event itself, so the test's hook assertions do not establish a real external launch or MailLink result. Conversion/sanitization remains a separate contract.
title: Rich-description clicks forward the anchor and event through the Calendar launch helper
